tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa las/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe'i sgrub pa phrin las dbang bskur bcas nyams su len bder bkod pa 'chi med bcud sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka kro dha rā dza ya/ bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor tshom bu dgu /tshe mchog bcud 'dzin phyag rgya'i skur shar ba'i// dngos grub bde blag thob phyir de'i sgrub thabs// smin byed dang bcas lag tu blang bder dgod// de'ang rtsa ba'i gzhung las/ rnal 'byor pa tshe ring ba ni dngos grub rnam gnyis mthar phyin par 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin zhing*/ tshe la bar du gcod pa'i rkyen drug gis tshe nyams pa'i rtags bzhi 'byung ba la gso ba'i thabs rnam pa gsum du gsungs pa'i gtso bo gso mkhan rnal 'byor pas shes par bya ba tshe gnas pa dang*/ 'phrog pa dang*/ bcing ba dang/ dgug pa dang*/ brnan pa ste tshe lung rnam pa lnga la bye brag lung rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis tshe sgrub pa'i thabs rnams bstan cing*/ de nyid sbyor dngos rjes tshang gis lag tu bstar ba la don bzhi/ dkyil 'khor bca' ba/ rdzas gsag pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi las rim/ tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las dngos so// dang po ni/ bkra shis yid 'ong mthun rkyen tshogs pa'i gnas su byang bgrod yar ngo'i dus tshes bzang por rten dang rgyan gyi bye brag ci 'byor pas mdzes par byas pa'i gung du stegs bu khebs ldan la bder 'dus dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs kyi ras bris bkram/ ma 'byor ba'am bsdu na maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar po/ gru chad ljang gu/ khyams phyogs mdog /de rgyab 'grub na sgo rdzogs spyi ltar bri/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor dbus su mañdzi la bum par nyer lnga'i rdzas/ byang sems dkar dmar/ ga pur/ cu gang*/ gi wang/ tsan dan dmar po/ chu sna/ ba dmar po'i 'o ma/ mngar gsum/ chos sman sbyar bas bkang la mgul chings bcas bzhag pa'i khar ban+dha mtshan ldan chang dang tshe 'bras ril bus bkang ba dar ras dmar pos bkab pa'i steng du tshe 'brang bum gzugs mgrin par ras skud dmar po la me tog dmar po'i phreng ba brgyus pas dkris shing rdo rje rgya gram gyis kha bkab pa bzhag

/phyogs bzhir bhan+dha bzhi chang dang chos sman gyis bkang ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi khyams su phur pa bcu/ phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mda' dar me long ldan pa bzhi gzug /chu gnyis nyer spyod/ sman gtor rak+ta sogs spyi ltar bshams/ bde 'dus phrin las che ba gtang na/ tshe/ zla gam/ dza gad sogs kyang bkod/ las bum/ phrin las la dgos pa'i gtor mchod tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du bya'o// gsum pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs chen mo'i gzhung bsrang bar gsungs pas 'grub na las byang bde rol btang la/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum sogs kyang de ltar las lha bskyed dngos gzhi 'dir gsal ba bsgyur/ 'on kyang thun bzhir nyams su len pa'i thun phyi ma rnams dang*/ dbang sgrub tsam la khyer bde ba'i slad du bsdu na/ thog mar bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod la/ sngon 'gro tshogs gsag pa'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen gtso dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhe sdang rdo rje'i skur gyur par bsam la/ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: thugs srog hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: phyogs mtshams 'khor lo rtsibs bcu 'bar: rtsibs steng dpal chen khro bo bcu: srung zlog phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir: sprul pa'i khro tshogs grangs med 'gyed: de'i phyir rno dbal mtshon cha'i gur: sra brtan mi shigs ra bas bskor: ye shes me lce kun tu 'bar: bgegs dang 'byung po rdul du brlag: oṃ ma hā kro dha rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: mchod pa byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bu: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: zhes byin gyis brlabs/ dngos gzhi la dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe bhañdza dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐/ dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang chen po bskal pa'i me phung 'bar ba'i dbus su: byol song lha klu pad+ma dkar po ge sar bcas pa dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig /phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i phyag mtshan zhi ba'i lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsnams pa/ yum gnam zhal dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dar dkar gyi leb chen gsol bas 'khyud pa yab yum gnyis dang phyag gi lha thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po shel ltar dag pa/ phyag g.yas thams cad na rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon thams cad na rin po che shel dkar gyi bum pa bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis gang ba/ mgul chings bye ru'i lu gu rgyud kyis bcings shing kha rgyan gser gyi rdo rje btsugs pa bsnams pa'o/

de ltar gsal ba'i dbu'i steng du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar po shel ltar dag pa/ phyag g.yas na rin po che'i phreng ba dang tshe'i za ma tog gi bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon bgrang phreng dang ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa/ de'i dbu steng na sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog shel ltar dag pa/ skyil krung mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// gtso bo yab yum gnyis la che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: shar du badz+ra he ru ka la yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: lhor 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: nub tu pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin la pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: byang du rdo rje gzhon nu la phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams gyis bskor ba: shar lhor bla med he ru ka la ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: lho nub tu bla ma rdo rje chos la rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: nub byang du dregs pa kun 'dul la 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: byang shar du stobs ldan nag po la dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: phyi yi 'khor yug tu dpal gyi bka' sdod kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po shel ltar dwangs pa: g.yas thams cad rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan: g.yon rnams rin po che shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa sha stag tu gsal bar gyur: gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas 'dir byon par bsam la/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rab 'byams pho brang nas: bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs:

chos nyid ngang nas 'gro don sku sprul pa: yab yum 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ling rtse dgu yi pho brang chen po 'dir: dug lnga me ltar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: byol song nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan khri la: bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la: phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor ma dang: sbyor sgrol glu dbyangs phyag rgya gar gyis mchod: 'dod yon lnga dang bla med tshogs mchod 'bul: tshe dbang mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: sa ma ya a la la ho: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: pho brang dgu rdzogs dur khrod gzhal yas khang: dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i lha: 'gro ba'i don du mngon sum sku sprul pa: che mchog yon tan yang dag 'dus pa'i rtsal: 'jam dpal sku gyur pad+ma dbang chen gsung: phrin las phur pa mngon rdzogs ma mo'i sku: rig 'dzin slob dpon 'jig rten 'dus pa'i gtso: drag po khro 'dus dkyil 'khor dgu yi lha: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nya las mkhan bcas: bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgrub pa bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga la: mchod cing bstod do dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: de ltar bsgom pa'i lha la sems bzung*/ byang chub sems dbab pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa tshe dpag med la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa phyag zhe gnyis kyi lha la thim/ de rnams kyi sku las byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi babs bdag gi lus la thim pas lus thams cad gang bar gyur/ rang gi thugs kar tsit+ta rin po che dkar po shel dag pa 'dra ba phyi nang mi sgrib pa'i tsit+ta sgo srung rta mgrin yab yum bzhugs pa/

de'i dbus su rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che shel gyi gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su tshe rten 'od dkar po'i dkyil du a dkar po la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer byung*/ ljags kyi dbang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa brgyud/ sna g.yas su zhugs nas klad pa dung khang dkar por 'phros/ slar srog rtsa rgal tshigs kyi rta la brgyud nas sna bug g.yon nas phyungs te/ slar thugs kar thim par gyur/ ces phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin yun ring bsgom/ de brtan pa dang spro bsdu ni/ sngags kyi phreng ba phyir 'phros pa'i 'od zer dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ bzla bya'i sngags de bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis me sgra chu sgra rlung sgra thams cad sngags kyi sgrar gyur/ sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas bag chags thul gyis bsregs nas 'od du zhu ste dkar ci li li 'dus te 'od dpag med la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas tshe dpag med la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba che mchog he ru ka'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ tsit+ta rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du dkar ltem ltem 'khyil/ mdun gyi bum pa dang yum gnam zhal ma'i mkha' klong dbyer med pa la snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi rdo rje'i sbubs nas bar ma chad pa babs/ bum pa yum gyi rang bzhin dkar ltem gyis gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ dpal dgu'i snying po rnams dang*/ zhi khro spyi bsdus/ oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: zhes zhi ba spyi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces khro bsdus rnams la/ ā yuḥpha la hūm̐ phaṭa ā: zhes btags pa la bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi bya/ stong tshigs spyi ltar phul/ 'dis bdag mdun bum gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin bzlas pa bcas chabs cig tu bsgrubs pa yin kyang bum sgrub zur du byed na/

stong pa'i ngang las/ a bh+rūm̐ zhes brjod pas tshe bum rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i nang du ma las nyi ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ sbrel ma'i bar du nṛ ljang gu gsal ba hūm̐ gi 'od kyis nṛ'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i skyon sbyangs nas nṛ le brgan du gyur/ de hūm̐ la thim/ de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ 'od zer slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas hūm̐ de nyid rdo rjer gyur/ slar yang de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ āṃḥ.a ro lik /pāṃ rā ga rā ti/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag na tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang du yum gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma'i phreng ba dang tshe bum 'dzin pa dang rol pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba'i thugs dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar tsit+ta rin po che shel gyi gzhal yas khang zlum po'i dbus su tshe rten thig le dkar po'i dkyil du nṛ le brgan gnas pa'i tsit+ta'i sgo srung rta mgrin dmar po bzhugs par gyur/ ces gsal btab pa tsam las cho ga'i yan lag gzhan gzhung du ma gsungs pas mi dgos so// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad 'od zer dang a nṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par bsdus te tshe'i rten dang bum nang du thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ā yur+dzñā na bhin+du dza: zhes bzla

/tshe 'phrog pa'i snying po/ ha ya gh+ri ba kro tī shwa ri sa ma ya de bī ā yu nṛ dza: zhes pa'ang ci 'grub bzlas la bum pa'i kha rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du rta mgrin gyis srung bar bsgom/ bzhi pa tshe'i phrin las kyi rim pa la tshe lung bcu gnyis yod pa'i dang po tshe mtshams bcad pa ni/ pad+ma he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ hūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin dpal gyi dpal: sku la mnga' mdzad dbang mchog pad+ma'i spyan: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: chags pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje che: pad+ma rgyal po kuṇ+ḍa lī: sprul pa'i khro bzhi mang po yis: tshe la gnas pa'i bgegs chen rnams: de yi dbugs choms dor dril la: gang tshe 'di yis gnod pa bgyis: dkar mo mgyogs byed 'od 'phro ma: rdo rje tshe mchog las mdzod cig: ā yu tshe bh+rūm̐ dzñā na bin 'du a pa ra mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa tshe lha bstod cing bsgrub pa ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sgrib pa'i dri ma rnam dag pa: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: sku yi rang bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: gsung gi rang bzhin spro dang yig 'brur ldan: thugs kyi rang bzhin skye med dbyings su 'khyil: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: gsung mchog rnam par dag pa'i gsung: spros bral chos kyi gsung mnga' ba: mnyam nyid gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: thugs mchog rnam par dag pa'i thugs: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba: mnyam nyid thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ba: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzod cig: mi sgrib tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ā yuḥtshe bh+rūm̐ yu yu:

de nas rigs kyi khro bo bskul ba/ hūm̐: bcom ldan che mchog yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan g.yas kyi 'khor lo yis: phyogs bcu'i khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: phyogs mtshams kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon na tshe yi bum pa'i nang du bstsal du gsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: badz+ra he ru yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba yis: shar phyogs khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: shar phyogs kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje dpal: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rin chen 'bar ba yis: lho phyogs khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: lho phyogs kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan rta mgrin yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag g.yas pad+ma 'bar ba yis: nub phyogs khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: nub phyogs kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rgya gram 'bar ba yis: byang phyogs khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: byang phyogs kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐:

bcom ldan bla med he ru yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba yis: shar lho khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: shar lho kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan rig 'dzin rdo rje tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba yis: lho nub khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: lho nub kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba yis: nub byang khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: nub byang kun nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan stobs ldan nag po yab yum tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba yis: byang shar khams kyi bgegs bcom nas: mi yi tshe dang phyugs kyi g.yang: zas kyi bcud dang nor gyi dbyig: byang shar khams nas sdus sdus la: g.yon gyi tshe bum nang du stsol: yab yum tshe gsol srog skyob mdzod: de nas tshe yi pho nya gtang ba/ dkar mo mgyogs byed 'od 'phro'i tshogs: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gug pa'i las mdzod cig: rdo rje lha mo lcags kyu ma: phyag na shel gyi bum pa bsnams: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang sgyur ma: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzod cig: nam mkha'i khams nas tshe drongs shig: rdo rje lha mo zhags pa ma: phyag mtshan bkra shis bum pa bsnams: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ma:

tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzod cig: sa yi khams nas tshe drongs shig: rdo rje lha mo lcags sgrog ma: phyag mtshan bye ru'i bum pa bsnams: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ma: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzod cig: chu yi khams nas tshe drongs shig: rdo rje lha mo dril 'khrol ma: phyag mtshan mthing shun bum pa bsnams: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ma: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzod cig: rlung gi khams nas tshe drongs shig: 'byung ba chen po nyon mongs ma: gnas 'dir tshe gsol srog skyob mdzod: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a pa ra mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐: de nas gsang ba'i yum bzhi'i tshe'i pho nya gtang ba 'di skad do// hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug ma: dkar mo zhi ba'i thod phreng can: khams gsum kun nas tshe khug cig: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gug ma: sngon mo g.yu yi lan phran can: srid gsum gnas nas tshe khug cig: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug ma: dmar mo mtshal gyi thig phran can: rgyud drug gnas nas tshe khug cig: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gug ma: ljang mo g.yu yi ral pa can: snyan pa'i sgra skad phyogs bcur sgrog: mchod stobs gnas nas tshe khug cig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a pa ra mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐: gsang ba'i yum bzhi'i sprul pa dang 'od zer tshogs kyis rnal 'byor pa'i tshe bcud dwangs ma'i dbyig rnams khams gsum gnas nas lcags kyus drangs: srid gsum gnas nas zhags pas bkug: rgyud drug gnas nas lcags sgrog gis bcings: mchod stobs gnas nas dril bus dgyes pa bskyed cing lha tshogs rnams kyi phyag gi bum par bsdus pas tshe bcud kyis gang bar mos: gsum pa dngos grub blang ba la gnyis/ dang po lha tshogs bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rnam dag yul gyi gzhal yas su: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: sku mdog gangs la nyi ma shar ba 'dra: phyag na rin chen phreng ba za ma tog:

bgrang phreng dang ni ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams: gnas par gyur pa'i 'gro drug la: tshe srog bzhugs pa'i gnas 'di lags: gang gi tshe ni gnang bar gyis: mi bsgrib tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: nub phyogs pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas: byams ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: thugs kar dpal gyi be'u zur brgyad la: byams ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: thugs mchog bdag gis bsgrub pa'i tshe lags kyis: byin gyis brlab cing bdag la dngos grub stsol: ā yu tshe bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo shel gyi zhing khams nas: rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i tshogs: dkar mo mgyogs byed zhi byed 'od 'phro'i tshogs: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje tshe mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol: lho phyogs baiḍūr+ya'i zhing khams nas: rin chen rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i tshogs: sngon mo drag shul 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje tshe mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol: nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga'i zhing khams nas: pad+ma rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i tshogs: dmar mo dbang sdud 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje tshe mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol: byang phyogs in+d+ra nī la'i zhing khams nas: las kyi rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i tshogs: dus glog ljang gu 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje tshe mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ā yuḥbadz+ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: kun tu bzang po yum gyi thugs ka nas: sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur ba'i yig 'bru shar: skal ldan tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol: spyi gtsug zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs: de yi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis: bgegs dang log 'dren mi gnas 'dir: tshe yi dngos grub brtan par mdzod:

lce steng pad+ma 'dab brgyad la: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs: de yi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis: bgegs dang log 'dren mi gnas 'dir: tshe yi dngos grub brtan par mdzod: thugs ka nyi ma'i gdan steng la: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs: de yi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis: bgegs dang log 'dren mi gnas 'dir: tshe yi dngos grub brtan par mdzod: lte ba rin chen zur brgyad la: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan bzhugs: de yi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis: bgegs dang log 'dren mi gnas 'dir: tshe yi dngos grub brtan par mdzod: thig le las kyi rgya gram la: bcom ldan don yod grub pa bzhugs: de yi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis: bgegs dang log 'dren mi gnas 'dir: tshe yi dngos grub brtan par mdzod: kun tu bzang mo yum gyi bha ga la: rak+ta zla gam 'od kyi zer 'phro ba: byang chub sems ni 'od du 'khyil: 'khyil cing rgyan yang 'khyil ba ste: byang chub sems la sku mi mnga': sku mchog dam pa nyid kyi sku: stong nyid sku la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems la gsung mi mnga': gsung mchog dam pa nyid kyi gsung: stong nyid gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems la thugs mi mnga': thugs mchog dam pa nyid kyi thugs: stong nyid thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas 'dir dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bskal pa mtha' yas mang por tshogs bsags nas: bskal par rnyed dka' de nyid thugs su chud: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: skal ldan tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol: shar phyogs lha mo tshe 'dzin ma: dkar mo shel mdog spyan 'phra ma: rdo rje sems dpas byin brlabs te: phyag na tshe yi g.yung drung bsnams: yang sprul phra mo grangs med kyis: dri za'i lag nas tshe drongs la: tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: lho yi lha mo tshe 'dzin ma: sngon mo g.yu mdog spyan 'phra ma: rin chen sems dpas byin brlabs te:

phyag na tshe yi g.yung drung bsnams: yang sprul phra mo grangs med kyis: gshin rje'i lag nas tshe drongs la: tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: nub kyi lha mo tshe 'dzin ma: dmar mo mtshal mdog spyan 'phra ma: chos kyi sems dpas byin brlabs te: phyag na tshe yi g.yung drung bsnams: yang sprul phra mo grangs med kyis: klu yi lag nas tshe drongs la: tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: byang phyogs lha mo tshe 'dzin ma: ser mo gser mdog spyan 'phra ma: las kyi sems dpas byin brlabs te: phyag na tshe yi g.yung drung bsnams: yang sprul phra mo grangs med kyis: gnod sbyin lag nas tshe drongs la: tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshur byon phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i sras: dad pa mthun pa'i dam tshig gis: gnas 'dir tshe gsol srog skyobs shig: pra mo mkhas pa'i pra mo ha: pra mo ha yis pra phob cig: tshe la dbang ba'i dpal 'bar ma: dpal 'bar mas ni tshe khug cig: tshe bdag chen mos tshe khug cig: byin bdag chen mos byin phob cig: oṃ bh+rūm̐ nṛ yu badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ dza: gnyis pa bsnyen pa 'bul ba ni/ gong du smos pa'i spro bsdu'i ting nge 'dzin gsal btab la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu she ā: zhes ci 'grub bzla/ tshe 'gugs pa ni/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ nṛ yu badz+ra ā yu she swā hā: tshe gso ba ni/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ nṛ yu badz+ra dzñā na ā yu she swā hā: tshe bstim pa ni/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ nṛ yu badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ ā be shā ya hūm̐: tshe bsring ba ni/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dzñā na sam bhā ro pa tsi te swā hā: mthar byin brtan cing dbang thang chus srid bskyed pa ni/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes pa rnams kyang bzla'o// bzhi pa tshe bgegs kyis brkus pa 'phrog pa ni/ thugs ka'i pad+ma he ru ka las sprul pa'i khro bo pad+ma kuṇ+ḍa lī gtum zhing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/

rdo rje gsal shing thogs pa spros te ri rab thal bar bshigs/ rgya mtsho'i gting nas dkrugs/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng na 'chi bdag gshin rje'i skra nas bzung*/ lus phyed tshal du bkas/ klad pa dang snying gi dkyil nas bsrung bya'i bla tshe bkug par bsam la/ hūm̐: sngags 'chang rgyal po gang na gnas pa na: phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor tshogs kyang de na gsal: phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas: sme sha nag mo byis snying za: de yi yang gsang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ha ya grī ba rta mchog dpal: phyag mtshan phyag na 'brug grus bsnams: 'brug dkar 'brug ljang 'brug sngon 'brug nag rnams: 'brug gi kha nas glog gi lce 'byin cing: 'brug gi kha nas gnam lcags thog kyang 'bebs: gnod sbyin dmar po rnams kyi klad pa 'gems: de yi sems kyi dkyil nas tshe drongs shig: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: chags pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje che: pad+ma rgyal po kuṇ+ḍa lī: sprul pa 'phro zhing mang po 'tshogs: tshe la gnas pa'i bgegs chen rnams: de yi gzugs mchog gting khrol la: gang gi tshe de snang bar gyis: bhan+da traṭ phaṭ: tshe la gnod pa'i bgegs chen po: gshin rje dmar po'i klad pa 'gems: de yi sems kyi dkyil nas tshe drongs la: mkha' dbyings rnam dag yum gyi gzhal yas nas: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: sku mdog gangs ri rtse la nyi shar 'dra: phyag na rin chen phreng ba za ma tog: bgrang phreng dang ni ne'u le bsnams: gnas par gyur pa'i 'gro drug la: tshe bzhag gnas ni 'di lags na: gang gi tshe de snang bar gyis: chags pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje che: pad+ma'i rgyal po he ru ka: sprul pa'i khro bo mang po yis: tshe la gnod pa'i bgegs rnams kun: de yi gzugs kyi gting bcom nas: gang gi tshe de snang bar mdzod: lag pa'i sor mo rgyab tu bsnol la drag tu dral lo// bhan+dha sarba traṭa phaṭa: lnga pa tshe blang zhing bla 'gugs ni/

khro bo'i sprul pas bgegs kyi gting dral te brkus pa'i bla tshe skar chen ltar gnas pa la: pad+ma he ru ka'i thugs ka dang: ba spu'i bu ga nas gsang ba'i yum sku mdog dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa mang po byung ste: zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i gwa'u 'dra ba'i nang du tshe bkug par gyur: lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la/ ā yur+dzñā na bh+rūm̐ dza: bgegs kyis bar du gcod cing rloms mi nus par khro bo mang pos bsrung mtshams bcad par gyur/ oṃ su ra badz+ra rak+ṣa yak+ṣa badz+ra ka pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: skul tshig kyang*/ hūm̐: tshe dang bla g.yu 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje lha mo lcags kyu 'dzin: nam mkha'i khams la dbang sgyur ma: khams gsum gnas nas tshe drongs shig: rin chen lha mo zhags pa ma: 'byung ba me la dbang sgyur ma: srid gsum gnas nas tshe khug cig: pad+ma lha mo lcags sgrog ma: 'byung ba chu la dbang sgyur ma: rgyud drug gnas nas tshe khug cig: las kyi lha mo dril bu ma: snyan pa'i sgra skad phyogs bcur sgrog: snang mdzad rlung la dbang sgyur ma: mchog gsum gnas nas tshe drongs shig: drug pa tshe dbab cing bstim pa ni/ lag gnyis dbab pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ lha mo rnams kyis bkug pa'i tshe de nyid bsrung bya'i lus kun la khyab par bstims shing khyad par snying gi dbus kyi tshe rten la thim pas bkrag dang gzi mdangs lham mer 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ ā be sha ya ā: gshin rje dmar po la sogs pa'i: thugs ka'i gnas nas tshe 'phrog pa'i: dbab pa'i cho ga byas pa yis: tshe dang bkrag dang gzi mdangs kun: thim nas lham mer 'bar bar gyur:

bcing zhing bzung ba ni/ snying ga'i gwa'u kha bsgrigs/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi rwa bzhis bsnol mar bsdoms rtser baṃ dmar po gsal/ badz+ra baṃ: baṃ las rdo rje lu gu rgyud dmar po byung ste rgya gram gyi rtse mo dam du bcings par gyur/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen gyis: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: rig 'dzin la sogs pho nya rnams: ma g.yel bden pa'i dam tshig gis: gnas 'dir las mdzod tshe khug cig: dad pas mthun pa'i dam tshig gis: tshur byon phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams: 'gro la phan pa'i thugs rje yis: gnas 'dir tshe spel srog skyobs shig: bdun pa g.yeng ba sdud pa ni/ dar gyi g.yab mo lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas drangs te/ ā yur+dzñā na bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: zhes pa dang*/ tshe dang bkrag thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus te: gang la bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim par gyur: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: rdo rje yum ste sangs rgyas spyan: rin chen shel gyi bum pa la: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas su: rdo rje 'bar bas rgyas btab ste: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas: tshe dbang thams cad brtan par mdzod: oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swā hā: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: rin chen yum ste gos dkar mo: bai ḍūr+ya yi bum pa la: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas su: rin chen 'bar bas rgyas btab ste: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas: tshe dbang thams cad brtan par mdzod: oṃ shang ka re shīn+taṃ ka re na gha ṭa ya gha ṭa ya gu ṭi ni swā hā: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: pad+ma yum ste mā ma kī: bye ru dmar po'i bum pa la: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas su: pad+ma 'bar bas rgyas gdab ste: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas: tshe dbang thams cad brtan par mdzod: oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe ni ka ṭe ka ṭaṃ ka ṭa swā hā: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: las kyi yum ste dam tshig sgrol:

in+d+ra nī la'i bum pa la: tshe dang bdud rtsi'i bkang nas su: ral gri 'bar bas rgyas gdab ste: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur nas: tshe dbang thams cad brtan par mdzod: oṃ tā re tut+tā re swā hā: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: bde gshegs yum ste dbyings phyug ma: rin chen mchong gi bum pa la: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas su: 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas btab nas: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas: tshe dbang thams cad brtan par mdzod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā de bī shrī ye swā hā: brgyad pa tshe zad pa gso ba ni/ sgrub pa po tshe dpag med yab yum gyi nga rgyal du zhugs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog gangs ri 'tsher ba la: rin chen phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spras: yid bzhin rin chen phreng ba dang: yid bzhin rin chen za ma tog: rin chen rgyan dang bum pa bzang: tshe yi gnas ni 'di lags so: tshe yi dbang po sgyu 'phrul can: dkar mo'i mdog la 'od 'phro ma: phyag na rin chen gang ba yi: phyag mtshan sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur: 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu nas: gnas par gyur pa'i 'gro drug la: phan pa'i tshe dbang sbyin mdzad ma: tshe dpag med pa yab yum gyis: de ring tshe 'di brtan par mdzod: na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta a yur+dzñā na sum+ba ni tsit+ta te dzo rā dzā ya: ta thā ga tā ya: ar+ha te: samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya: tad ya thā oṃ sarba sam skā ra pa ri shud+dhe dharma te ga ga na sa mud ga te: swā bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā nā ya pa ri wā re swā hā: zhes bzlas pas/ tshe dpag tu med pa yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems char gyi rgyun bzhin babs: bsrung bya'i lus thams cad la khyab cing bsnan te bsdams pas tshe dang gzi brjid 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur: dgu pa tshe ldeg pa brtan par byed pa'i skul ni/ bskal pa grangs med mang por tshogs bsags pa'i:

skye shi las 'das rnal 'byor chen po yi: rgyal bas rtogs dka' de nyid thugs su chud: bcom ldan tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: kun tu bzang mo yum gyi bha ga las: lha tshogs cir yang 'gyur ba'i cho 'phrul gyis: bcom ldan tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: khro bo khro mo'i thugs ka nas: lcags kyu dkar dang dmar gyi zhags kyis bcings: de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ka man chad nas: mthu chen 'byung po lha klu bgegs la sogs: de yi snying gi dkyil nas tshe drongs la: bcom ldan tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: lcags kyus tshe bzung ba'i phyag rgya bcings la/ ā yur+dzñā na bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: zhes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ka nas thugs rje byang chub sems kyi char babs pas: 'dod khams dang gzugs khams kyi lha bsod nams che zhing: gzi brjid ldan pa ma bdud srin po la sogs pa'i tshe dang bsod nams 'phrog nas spyan ma la sogs pas dbang bskur cing byin gyis brlabs: tshe bcud sgo gsum la phab cing rgyas par byas te zla ba rgyas pa ltar gsal bar gyur: badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ: sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā: bcu pa tshe la bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bskrad pa ni/ rang gi sor mo g.yon pa lnga spyan ma sogs yum lngar gsal ba'i phyag mtshan lcags kyus nad dang bgegs kyi sbyor ba ngan pa phyung ste byab cing mtshams bcad: g.yas pa lnga la khro bo lngar gyur te: tshe la gnod pa'i bgegs tshar gcod par gyur: hūm̐: dkar mo rgyas 'debs zhi byed mgyogs ma'i tshogs: 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur cing: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: thugs rje rgya mtsho rba klong 'khyil ba ni: rmongs byed dmar mo dbang sdud chags pa'i sku: snang srid mgyogs ma'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ma: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: rgyas byed ser mo tshe 'phel rgyas 'debs ma:

thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'dren pa'i gtso mo ste: tshe dang gzi brjid 'dren pa'i las mdzad ma: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: sngon mo brlag byed drag po'i shugs 'bar ma: rmongs shing 'dren pas drag po'i las mdzad ma: log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhom pa'i phyir: tshe la gnod pa'i bgegs rnams rdul du rlog: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug pa: tshe yi bdag po'i mtshan ni mi 'khrugs pa: tshe yi yum gyi mtshan ni sangs rgyas spyan: tshe yi mgon po'i mtshan ni yul 'khor srung: tshe yi khro bo'i mtshan ni stobs po che: mgyogs byed pho nya'i mtshan ni rdo rje lcags kyu ste: rdo rje lcags kyus nam mkha'i khams khongs la: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas tshe drongs shig: badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gug pa: tshe yi bdag po'i mtshan ni rin chen 'byung: tshe yi yum chen mtshan ni gos dkar mo: tshe yi mgon po'i mtshan ni 'phags skyes po: tshe yi khro bo'i mtshan ni gshin rje gshed: tshe yi pho nya'i mtshan ni rdo rje zhags pa ste: rdo rje zhags pas nam mkha'i khams khongs la: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas tshe drongs shig: rat+na ā yu dzñā na trāṃ bh+rūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug pa: tshe yi bdag po'i mtshan ni 'od dpag med: tshe yi yum gyi mtshan ni mā ma ki: tshe yi mgon po'i mtshan ni spyan mi bzang: tshe yi khro bo'i mtshan ni rta mchog dpal: tshe yi pho nya'i mtshan ni lcags sgrog ma: rdo rje lcags sgrog nam mkha'i khams khongs la: nub phyogs klu yi lag nas tshe drongs shig: pad+ma dzñā na ā yuḥhrīḥbh+rūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs pa: tshe yi bdag po'i mtshan ni don yod grub: tshe yi yum gyi mtshan ni dam tshig sgrol: tshe yi mgon po'i mtshan ni rnam thos sras: tshe yi khro bo'i mtshan ni bdud rtsi 'khyil:

tshe yi pho nya'i mtshan ni dril bu ma: rdo rje dril bus nam mkha'i khams khongs la: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas tshe drongs shig: karma ā yuḥdzñā na ha bh+rūm̐: shar phyogs rdo rje 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rdo rje phra men me yi ral pa can: spyan mig dri med chu zla 'bum gyis gzigs: phyag cha rdo rje mang po skar ltar 'khrugs: 'dul byed zhabs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba yis: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas tshe khug cig: lho phyogs me ri dmar po'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje sgron me me yi ral pa can: me yi tshwa tshwa mang po skar ltar 'khrugs: ral pa me stag mang pos stong khams gtibs: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug cig: nub phyogs zangs ma dmar po'i zangs kyi gzhal yas su: rdo rje khrag 'thung khrag gi ral pa can: khrag dang zhag gi thig les rgyan du byas: lag pa khrag sder dmar po gtams pa yis: nub phyogs klu yi lag nas tshe khug cig: byang phyogs lcags ri sngon po lcags kyi gzhal yas su: lcags mdog sngon mo lcags kyi mche gshog can: lag pa lcags sder sngon po lcags kyi kha bltams pas: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug cig: bcu gcig pa sbed cing brtan par bya ba la gnyis las/ dang po kha bcings nas sbed pa ni/ rgyas 'debs ma yis rgyas thob cig: ci ltar rgyal pos rgyas btab nas: bran rnams 'gal bar me byed bzhin: bdag nyid chen pos rgyas btab bo: su yang 'gal bar mi bya 'o: tshe 'dzin mas ni tshe zungs shig: bdud dang mu stegs gang la yang: ma shor bar ni dam du bzung: sbed byed rnams ni tshe sbos shig: sbed byed khyed kyis tshe sbas na: mthu chen lha srin gang gis kyang: de la mthong bar nus pa min: spel byed mas ni tshe spel cig: spel byed khyed kyis tshe spel na: nam yang zad par 'gyur ba min: zhes dang*/ ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung: tshe 'dzin ma yis tshe zungs shig:

skrod byed ma yis bgegs skrod cig: spel byed ma yis tshe spel cig: rtogs byed ma yis tshe rtogs shig: mthu chen rnams kyis mthu stsol cig: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: ces bskul lo// gnyis pa tshe brtan par bya ba ni/ cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa'i: 'khor lo'i go cha bla na med: dam pa nyid du mdzad du gsol: cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa: rdo rje'i go cha bla na med: sra zhing mkhregs par mdzad du gsol: cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa: rin chen go cha bla na med: yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog: cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa: pad+ma'i go cha bla na med: gsung mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol: cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa: rgya gram go cha bla na med: phrin las phun sum tshogs par mdzod: tshe 'di ri rab rtse na gnas kyang rung: rgya mtsho'i gting na gnas kyang rung: bdud dang srin po'i lag na gnas kyang rung: rgyal po brgya byin lag na gnas kyang rung: sa bdag sa srin lag na gnas kyang rung: tshe 'di yo ba bdog na bsrang du gsol: nyams pa 'dug na bsab tu gsol: yar ba bdog na dgug tu gsol: oṃ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ trāṃ bh+rūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ hā bh+rūm̐: zhes pas/ tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ltar sra zhing lhun po ltar 'gyur med du brtan par bsam/ bcu gnyis pa tshe'i dbang blang zhing smon lam gdab pa ni gsham du 'byung ba ltar la/ dbang blang ba ni bsnyen sgrub grub pa'i rjes sogs las rgyun du sbyor mi dgos/ srung ma'i gtor chog 'grub na 'dir sbyar/ de nas phrin las rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod mdor bsdus byed par spro na/ tshogs rdzas kyi dngos po ci 'byor ba bshams shing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chus// tshogs kyi dngos po bsregs gtor bkrus// slar yang bh+rūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥs// ngo mtshar mchod sprin chen por gyur// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ

lan gsum/ tshogs rten spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings 'gyur med 'og min zhing khams nas// bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod yon mchod bzhes tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas tshogs phud cha gsum du spros la/ dang po mchod pa ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes 'bul/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dang ci 'gal ba// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// yig brgya bzla/ tshogs tha ma ni/ e nṛ tri zhes dmigs bya rten dang bcas pa bskyed/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dgug gzhug bya/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sarba nṛ tri sha trūm mā ra ya rbad/ ces bsgral la/ dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus// dug gsum dbyings su sbyangs pa mchod pa'i sprin// zag med bdud rtsir sbar nas 'bul lags na// rngams pa'i stabs kyis dgyes par bzhes su gsol// māṃ sa rak+ta keng ni ri ti a mṛta pū dza khā hi/ zhes stob/ de nas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa brlabs/ oṃ ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ging lang dbang phyug ma// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad// pho nya la sogs lhag sdud tshogs// dpal gyi pham phab 'di gsol la// sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/

zhes 'bul/ he ru ka dpal grong khyer du// tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces smon lam gdab bo// mthar gtang rag gi don du/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma sha na puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ gan+dhaṃ nai wid+yaṃ shab+daṃ pū dza hoḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes dang*/ yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ tshogs mgron sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na badz+ra muḥ sa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbyings su gshegs/ bdag nyid dam ye dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bltas la/ hūm̐: chos nyid skye ba med pa las: 'gag med dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shar: 'gag pa nyid na 'gag med pa: spros bral ka dag klong du thim: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ slar yang bdag nyid he ru ka'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/

zhes thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang zhing gnas gsum bsrung*/ gsham nas 'byung ba ltar tshe'i smon lam gdab/ mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'gyur ba med pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rab 'byams rgyal ba rnams kyi gnas thob nas// 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog / ces dge ba bsngo/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub char 'beb zhi khro bka' brgyad lha// dregs pa'i sde dpon dam can gter srung sogs// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ ༈ /'di'i sgo nas tshe'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bca' gzhi dang 'don sgrub bshad ma thag pa ltar tshogs gsag nas bzung*/ bcu pa bgegs kyi 'tshe ba bskrad pa'i bar du gtang*/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed bzlas bya/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang la bskrad/ las byang ltar mtshams bcad/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de la 'dir rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la bka' babs shing thugs dam gyi lha mchog rtsod med du grags pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i bka' srol snga phyi du mar byon pa rnams kyi nang nas rtsa bar gyur pa/ chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi sku'i rnam 'phrul/ gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi rgyal po/ mnga' bdag nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer gyis lho brag mkho mthing lha khang gi rnam snang sku rgyab nas chos rgyal chen po'i bla dpe spyan drangs par mdzad pa'i bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos skor las/ thugs rje dang bka' drin tshad ma mchis pa'i bdag nyid gu ru rin po che pad+mā ka ras phyi rabs kyi 'gro ba tshe thung zhing tshe la bar du gcod pa mang po dang ldan pa la phan gdags pa'i slad du rgyud las zab mo'i nying khu phyungs par mdzad pa/

bskyed rdzogs chen po'i las gzhung dang 'brel ba'i man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa tshe lung rnam pa bcu gnyis dang ldan pa bkra shis tshe'i sgrub pa'i dbang bskur bgyi ba la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / thal mo me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'chi med gtso bo khyod la 'dud// thar lam chen po bdag 'dod de// de nyid dbang dang dam tshig dang*// mgon po dpa' bor skyabs gsol nas// theg chen khang par gzhug pa dang*// mkhyen rab ye shes bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer med pa bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad 'chi med tshe'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gsal ba'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ mtha' skor du yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa tshul bzhin bya ba'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes lan gsum/ dbang don rgyud la brtan pa ni dam tshig dang sdom pa la rag las pa yin pas dam bca' rnam pa gsum brtan por bzung ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra// de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig

/spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa// 'gro la phan phyir bdag gis spyad// byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ni// srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na// rdo rje rgyal pos byin rlob mdzod// dus ngan tha ma'i 'jig rten 'dir// sangs rgyas mdzad dka' bdag gis sgrub// byang chub spyod dka' bdag gis spyad// rdo rje rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag cag bsam pa 'grub gyur cig / gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god cing ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun la dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /oṃ badz+ra a mṛta sogs kyis bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pad+ma dkar po ge sar bcas pa dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka sogs las byang gi mngon rtogs ltar brjod/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa gsal thob/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams kyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer gyi snang ba nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba 'phros/ chos kyi dbyings rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad sgrub chen bka' brgyad 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par bzhengs nas/ char babs pa ltar byon te khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos shig / spos rol dbyangs dang bcas spyan 'dren sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ zhi khro spyi bsdus sngags sham bu can gyi mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā: zhes btags pa brjod la dbab/ ye shes pa'i byin gyi brlab kyi rgyun sgo gsum la brtan par byas par mos shig

/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag la brtan par bya/ de dag gis sngon 'gro'i rim pa grub/ dngos gzhi'i tshe dbang bskur ba la rtsa ba'i gzhung las/ tshe mtshams bcad cing tshe yi lha tshogs bsgrub/ tshe la dngos grub blang zhing lha tshogs bskul: bgegs kyis brkus pa 'phrog la tshe blang bla 'gug bya: tshe dbab bstim zhing tshe ni bcing bar bya: tshe 'phyan g.yeng ba sdud cing tshe ni zad pa gso: tshe ni ldeg pa brtan cing bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bskrad: tshe ni kha bcing tshe ni brtan par bya: zhes gsungs pa'i tshe lung bcu gnyis kyi phrin las rim pa bzhin bsgrub pa la/ thog mar tshe rten gsal gdab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i snying khar tsit+ta rin po che dkar po shel dag pa 'dra ba phyi nang mi sgrib pa'i tsit+ta'i sgo srung dpal rta mgrin yab yum bzhugs pa/ de'i dbus su rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che shel gyi gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su tshe rten 'od dkar po'i thig le a yig dkar pos mtshan par sgoms shig /hūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin dpal gyi dpal: sogs mtshams bcad pa nas bzung*/ bcu pa bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bskrad pa'i mjug / byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug cig: bar du gtang*/ bsnyen bzlas rnams nyer gcig nas bdun re'i bar bya/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dgongs pa mdzad/ yum lngas bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur/ 'khor rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dbang gi phrin las mdzad par gyur/ rnam bum gyi mgo bo'i gnas lngar rim bzhin dbang bskur la/ hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: bde gshegs gsang ba gsum las byung: khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa: bde gshegs dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:

hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung: khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa: rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rin chen gsang ba gsum las byung: khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa: rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: pad+ma gsang ba gsum las byung: khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa: pad+ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung: khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa: las kyi dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: zhes bskur la bum chu sbyin/ tshe'i bum dbang bskur pas rgyal po yab yum bcu'i sku'i tshe dang longs spyod dang ldan te: skye shi med pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig: tshe sra zhing mkhregs par gyur cig: cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs par gyur cig: tshe 'brang ril bu lag g.yas su gtad la/ zla gam rdo rje dbang gi lung: bdud rtsi gsang ba tshe yi lung: pra ma si tis dbang bskur bas: gter chen brgyad kyi dbang thob shog: gong gsal tshe gzungs bzla/ tshe chang sbyin cing smon lam gdab pa/ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: rnam par dag pa yum gyi mkha' dbyings nas: rdo rje g.yung drung mi shigs dpal gyi sku: byang chub sems mchog rol pa'i thabs kyis bcos/ gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor nas: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: skal ldan rnams la tshe yi dngos grub thob gyur cig: ces brjod/ de nas gong gsal bcu gcig pa sbed cing brtan par bya ba/ rgyas 'debs ma yis rgyas thob cig: ces pa nas/ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ hā bh+rūm̐: bar brjod/

de nas smon lam gdab pa/ bag chags sdig pa thams cad byang gyur cig: tshe yi gzi brjid thams cad me ltar 'bar gyur cig: deng 'dir tshe yi dngos grub bstsal nas kyang: bskyed pas mi nub tshe yi dngos grub legs: bsdus pas srid pa gsum gyi gzi mdangs ldan: 'phros pas khams gsum kun gyi bkrag dang ldan: bcings pas 'bral med rdo rje lu gu rgyud: brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje lhun po 'dra: bdag ni skal ldan rdo rje dam tshig ste: sku gsung thugs mchog tshe yi dngos grub thob gyur cig: tshe dbang bskur cing bsgrubs pas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku tshe dang longs spyod la mnga' brnyes nas skye shi med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur cig: tshe mi 'gyur ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig: tshe brtan pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig: skye shi med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur cig: ces brjod/ de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas par spel zhing me tog gi char dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrag /dbang gi rjes dam tshig bzung ba/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi ltar bya/ chos gter srung ma'i gtor 'bul gang 'grub dang*/ phrin las rjes kyi rim pa tshogs mchod nas shis brjod bar gong du smos pa ltar bya'o/ khyad chos du mas rab zab lung bcu gnyis// gzhung bzhin bsgrub pa'i lag len gsal byas dges// 'brel bcas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog brnyes// klong dgu'i ye shes 'gyur med srog 'grub shog /ces pa 'di nyid kun gzigs rdo rje 'chang 7'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ dza ka dang dge mang mchog sprul bcas rnam pa gsum gyis gsung bskul gnang ba ltar/ rje bla ma nyid kyi dgongs don dang phyag bzhes kyi rjes su 'brang*/ gzhung rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa sor bzhag tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwar bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
